title: Extension of Last Date for Submission of Semester Fee – Fall 2025
text:
📢 Fee Submission Deadline Extended

This is to inform all students that the last date for submission of semester fees for

Fall 2025
has been extended till

Tuesday, February 3, 2026
.

All students are required to deposit their dues on or before the extended date.
Failure to do so will result in
withholding of results
, and a

fine will be imposed
strictly in accordance with University rules.

Students are advised to ensure timely payment to avoid any inconvenience.
